title: Process and Threads Problem #1
text: In modern Operating Systems (Process and Threads), how does the kernel guarantee safety or optimize performance for scenario #1?
explanation: Atomic operations, semaphores, and monitor invariants ensure race conditions and deadlocks are prevented.

options.text: By disabling user space process execution entirely
By allowing uncontrolled simultaneous access to shared critical memory
By switching the CPU clock to single-cycle execution mode
By enforcing hardware-assisted synchronization primitives and mutual exclusion
